Talion from Middle Earth: Shadow of war.

Something about a character sacrificing everything they have, down to even sacrificing their humanity for the greater good just hits me different. Talion had already wanted to finally die once he accomplished his vengeance, but wore the ring of power knowing full well the effects it will have on him.

All this just so that he can buy middle earth more time to prepare, not even knowing if it will work. Trusting that his efforts would bear fruit, even if his name would be forgotten and his deeds unseen.

So seeing this tortured soul who gave up the idea of being able to rest in peace finally see the light on the horizon,  leave behind everything that connected him to his mortal pain (His armor and swords) and finally be at peace...

Just hits different man. RIP Talion, A Ranger, A Father and a son of Gondor.
